Chapter 7178: Ready, Little Baldy?!

Chapter 7178: Ready, Little Baldy?!

The defenders’ dao power and vitality reached the peak upon receiving assistance from Golden, Ruin, Divine Firmament, Ancient, and Stygian.

The cracks on the wall disappeared once more while confidence resurfaced.

Unfortunately, they faced unending tribulations. By this point, the pond above had turned into an ocean.

The combined onslaught left Desolate Frontier feeble despite having the support of five major worlds.

“Little Baldy, are you ready?!” Origin Heaven Emperor became impatient.

“Ready, come!” Duality Master appeared, raising his hands.

“Very well!” Empress Hong Tian and Origin Heaven Emperor opened a hole in the wall, allowing tribulations to course through.

“Villainous heaven, I accept it all!” Duality shouted before being obliterated by the concentrated wave.

His flesh and blood suddenly became the border for the tribulations, leading it around Desolate Frontier. Once there were enough bolts, he guided them to the center.

There was a pit purposely refined here with a lightning bolt pinned at the bottom. This once belonged to the messenger. Alas, it was feeble and on the verge of dissipating.

“Boom!” Duality Master baited the bolts into hitting the one pinned on the ground, igniting it in the process.

“Buzz.” It absorbed the waves of lightning bolts and became stronger.

“Rumble!” The bolt absorbed more and more, making it easier for the wall to last.

“There’s hope.” A spectator said.

The wall gradually stabilized, seemingly capable of enduring the weakened waves.

Unfortunately, they celebrated too early. Up above, a figure appeared in a blinding manner.

Any immortal who looked up instantly vomited blood. Only a few withstood the unbearable pressure.

“The high heaven...” Someone shouted.

Tribulations surged again, strong enough to pierce the wall with holes this time.

“Ahh!” Some empowered immortals exploded into bits in the blink of an eye, including Peashooter, Lightless Immortal, and Nightfall Immortal Monarch.

“Baldy!” Empress Hong Tian and Origin Heaven Emperor rushed forward, attempting to divert the waves toward Duality Master.

“That’s fine!” He continued to lead them into the pit.

The source bolt crazily absorbed more bolts, but there was a limit.

“Shit, too much to absorb. Duck egg, what are you waiting for?!” Duality shouted.

“Yes!” A figure appeared, forcing all of Heavenrealm to resonate.

Primordial lights erupted even in the destroyed worlds. Just like that, primordial trees appeared without needing permission. This happened in Epoch’s Dawn and Heavenly Fortress as well.

“Come!” The figure opened a portal to a real primordial tree. It grew into space, heading straight for the ocean of tribulations.
